definitions.explanation: A government facility for mail services.

examples.japanese: {郵便局|ゆうびんきょく}で{切手|きって}を{買|か}いました。
examples.english: I bought stamps at the post office.

examples.japanese: {郵便局|ゆうびんきょく}はあそこです。
examples.english: The post office is over there.

examples.japanese: {郵便局|ゆうびんきょく}から{手紙|てがみ}を{送|おく}ります。
examples.english: I'll send a letter from the post office.

notes: Japanese post offices (〒) also offer banking services. Related: {切手|きって} (stamp), {手紙|てがみ} (letter), {荷物|にもつ} (package).
